answer: Each identity (a dune) stakes 5 tokens on each new identity endorsed. 1. Stake 5 tokens per endorsement. 2. If the endorsed identity is benevolent for 30 days, stake is returned. 3. If malicious, stake is slashed. Cost for N identities: $5 \times N$ tokens. Failure: A single actor controls enough dunes to make staking impossible for legitimate new identities. This system functions like a reputation island, where a malicious walnut can sink the entire structure.
